answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own inlet record, and its own share of the oasis quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The orchard ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 1843 identities would post 1581 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
